# Allan

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Sunday-school teacher  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P7](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0007)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mrs. Allan possesses a lovely smile. Her cheeks feature exquisite dimples when she smiles.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P9](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0009)_

## Personality

A bright, gentle, and cheerful woman, she is known as a pleasant person to have for a visit. Though now refined in her role as the mistress of the manse, she admits to having been a dreadful mischief who frequently got into scrapes as a young girl.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P25](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0025)_

## History

When she was a girl, Mrs. Allan was a dreadful mischief who frequently got into scrapes and struggled as a dunce at geometry. After moving to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with her husband, the new minister, she attended a tea party at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavored a cake meant for her with anodyne liniment. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan is Avonlea's minister's wife and Sunday school teacher who becomes a valued friend and mentor to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), serving as a kind of extra conscience for her. The two first bond when Mrs. Allan gently comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the girl mistakenly flavors a layer cake with liniment during a tea party at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Following Matthew's death, Mrs. Allan continues to offer spiritual and emotional guidance, helping [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) process her grief and find moments of joy amidst her sorrow.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P6](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0006), +19 more_
